Package edu.ucsb.cs.citelines.services

Interface CitationMetadataResolver

All Known Implementing Classes:
CrossrefResolver, OpenAlexService, SemanticScholarResolver
public interface CitationMetadataResolver
A source of scholarly-work metadata and citation-graph data (references/citations), e.g. OpenAlexService, SemanticScholarResolver, or CrossrefResolver. CitationGraphService tries resolvers in a fixed priority order, falling back to the next one only when the previous one has no record at all for a given DOI — see docs/design/OpenAlex-MVP-to-full-tiered-fallback-engine.md for why this is a waterfall rather than a union of all resolvers' results.

    • resolveByDoi

      Optional<ResolvedWork> resolveByDoi(String doi)
      Looks up a single work by DOI. Empty if this resolver has no record for that DOI.

    • getReferences

      List<ResolvedWork> getReferences(ResolvedWork sourceWork, int maxResults)
      The works sourceWork cites, most-relevant-first, capped at maxResults. May require additional network calls beyond the one that produced sourceWork (e.g. to hydrate sourceWork.referencedWorkIds()), or may simply return sourceWork.embeddedReferences() if this resolver returns them inline.

    • getCitations

      List<ResolvedWork> getCitations(ResolvedWork sourceWork, int maxResults)
      The works that cite sourceWork, most-relevant-first, capped at maxResults. Resolvers with no citation-discovery capability at all (e.g. Crossref's public API has no citing-works endpoint) always return an empty list.
